title: Dark Web Profile: Nova Ransomware
content_md: Nova is a ransomware group that operates a Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model to extort organizations through file encryption and data theft. Nova equips affiliates with a Rust-based encryptor and threatens to publish stolen information on a dedicated Dark Web leak site. With victim claims spanning multiple industries and countries, the group threatens organizations well beyond a single sector or region. The group first surfaced as RALord in March 2025 and rebranded as Nova the following month. Who Is Nova Ransomware (Formerly RALord)? Nova is a financially motivated ransomware group that recruits affiliates, supplies encryption tools, and uses stolen data to extort organizations. After the rebrand, Nova carried existing RALord victim listings onto the renamed leak site and added affiliate registration and communication channels. Nova RaaS threat actor card Nova claims that its members had taken part in other, unnamed ransomware groups in 2018 and 2020. Although unverified, this account suggests that the Nova brand may be newer than the individuals behind it. The group names financial gain as its primary motive and says it selects victims based on exploitable weaknesses, not industry. Nova advertises
